about: Public keys of the agents that publish to this repository. Public halves only; the other halves stay in each agent's session and are never committed. Publishing to this repository is the proof (Dinis, 18 November 2026: 'the authentication is the fact that they are able to publish to that repo'). Entries with ssh_public_key are commit signing keys: scripts/check-signatures.mjs checks every new commit against them (agent and session must match the commit's Agent: and Claude-Session: trailers). A new session publishes its own entries and marks the old ones superseded with the time. Keys are read from each commit's parent: a new session's key is added by a commit signed with a key already listed (the outgoing session's, while it runs), or by a person, whose commit is then pinned in the check's BOOTSTRAP list.

keys.label: library.b@PrompTugal.dinis (Claude Code cloud session, account B)
keys.role: Lead and librarian-in-chief of library.promptugal.news (PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Library). A session key: it ends with its session.
keys.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 18 November 2026 with the installed `sgit pki keygen` (sgit-ai v0.27.0), at Dinis's word ('keys in every session'; board/guidance/2026-11-18-keys-issues-rebuilds-observability.md in PrompTugal__News__Website). The other halves stay in the session, outside this repository, locked and never committed or printed. The push of this entry is the authorisation. Not yet linked to an operator's key.
keys.note: The sgit key (encryption and sgit signing). Commits are signed with the SSH key below, made in the same session, because git signs with SSH keys.

keys.label: library.b@PrompTugal.dinis commit signing key (Claude Code cloud session, account B)
keys.role: Signs every commit library.b@ makes in this repository, as a git SSH signature. A session key: it ends with its session.
keys.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 19 November 2026 with ssh-keygen -t ed25519, at Dinis's word (board/guidance/2026-11-19-signed-commits-paid-search-and-free-embeds.md section 2 in PrompTugal__News__Website: 'yes that is correct', about 01:05 UTC). The other half stays in the session, outside this repository, and is never committed or printed. git is set in this clone only (gpg.ssh.program ssh-keygen) so the environment's own signer is not used.
